visualReview.notes: Inspected 54 current frames: 12 portable, 12 shared-material/flat-map and 30 Earth-rig/native-terrain/tier frames. The modern twin carriageways, narrow actual median opening, three lanes per direction, outer pavements, separate traffic/pedestrian rails, four girder lines, cross members and open concrete pier legs remain coherent. Four separate triangular glazed bank access enclosures retain schematic internal stair flights, shaft frames and bridge-side landings near; district/skyline use opaque aggregate proxies. Three existing 256px surface graphs supply concrete, painted metal and aggregate/asphalt approximation; road paint and transparent glass are untextured PBR definitions. No private or embedded images. Named PMTiles road/path pairs and four access connectors establish the signed northwest city-bank/southeast park-bank frame. A wrong neighboring-bridge aerial was explicitly excluded. All 30 Earth frames render the unmodified standard global terrain and a separate schematic water rectangle. Endpoints sit at coarse ground+0.25m; land footings embed into that field and river foundations extend to reference datum. Four focused tests prove source/tier bytes, native endpoints, real median and pier/river apertures, and actual production replacement of both roadways/outer bridge paths while retaining the lower bank street and river promenade. Default turntables are small for this long structure; authored road, pier, lift and underside views supply detail coverage. Exact original grades, pier positions, haunches, lift internals and operating mechanisms, glass optics, water levels and physical device timing remain reconstructed or unmeasured. Light fixtures are simplified single-head lamps per edge rather than an exact original hardware schedule.

siteIntegrationReview.source: Standard viewer PMTiles and two ordinary global Terrarium tiles; no bespoke survey/terrain acquisition.
siteIntegrationReview.notes: Native field is unmodified. Its 6m sampling oversamples coarse source DEM. Both road endpoints follow ground+0.25m; bank foundations embed into the field and submerged river footings extend to the reference datum. The water rectangle is a schematic separate fixture, not an exact bank polygon or measured river level. Runtime preservation of the crossing lower street and promenade was separately tested with retained map coordinates.

runtimeLodReview.notes: Four authored browser tiers, at most five draws, no embedded/private images and separate position/normal streams. Detailed master is preserved separately. Phone/laptop physical timings remain unmeasured.
